assignments_insert_as_coach.name: assignments_insert_as_coach
assignments_insert_as_coach.withCheck:

    select 1 from "enrolments"
    where "enrolments"."id" = "assignments"."enrolment_id" and "enrolments"."coach_id" = (select auth.uid())

feedback_insert_as_coach.name: feedback_insert_as_coach
feedback_insert_as_coach.withCheck:
("feedback"."coach_id" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (
    select 1 from "submissions"
    inner join "enrolments" on "enrolments"."id" = "submissions"."enrolment_id"
    where "submissions"."id" = "feedback"."submission_id" and "enrolments"."coach_id" = (select auth.uid())
  ))

profiles_select_enrolment_counterpart.name: profiles_select_enrolment_counterpart
profiles_select_enrolment_counterpart.using:
(exists (
    select 1 from "enrolments"
    where "enrolments"."coach_id" = "profiles"."id" and "enrolments"."student_id" = (select auth.uid())
  ) or exists (
    select 1 from "enrolments"
    where "enrolments"."student_id" = "profiles"."id" and "enrolments"."coach_id" = (select auth.uid())
  ))

media_assets_select_library.name: media_assets_select_library
media_assets_select_library.using:
exists (
        select 1 from "library_items"
        where "library_items"."active"
          and ("library_items"."demo_media_id" = "media_assets"."id" or "library_items"."backing_track_media_id" = "media_assets"."id")
      )

media_assets_ready_is_playable.name: media_assets_ready_is_playable
media_assets_ready_is_playable.value: "media_assets"."status" <> 'ready' or ("media_assets"."src" is not null and "media_assets"."peaks_src" is not null and "media_assets"."duration_sec" is not null)
